title: Apply for Spark Ads authorization
content_data:
Use this endpoint to send a request to apply for TikTok creator's authorization to boost their video for a TikTok One (TTO) Creator Marketplace campaign. ## Request **Endpoint** **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by a TTO Creator Marketplace account. For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/obtain-authorization-and-authentication-from-a-tto-creator-marketplace-account/v1.3).| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/json`. | ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |video_id {Required}|string| ID of the video that is created under the creator account.

The video needs to meet the following requirement:
  • The video has been uploaded and tagged as branded content, and the creator has linked the video to a TTO Creator Marketplace campaign via the invite link (`invite_link`) created via [/tto/tcm/campaign/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693549459458).
    • You can get `video_id` via [/tto/tcm/campaign/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693562720258) or [/tto/tcm/report/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693573340162).
| |tcm_account_id {Required}|string|The ID of the TTO Creator Marketplace account.

To obtain the IDs of the TTO Creator Marketplace accounts that you can access via `Access-Token`, use [/tto/oauth2/tcm/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693478150146).| |authorization_days |number| Authorization validity period (in days).

Value range: 1-365.
Default value: 30.

Note: You can use this field to specify the validity period of the authorization, or to request an update for the validity period of approved authorization.
The actual validity period can be different from the validity period you request, because the creator can choose any validity period (one to 365 days) when approving the request. | |action|string|The action to take.

Enum value:

  • `EXTEND`: To extend the validity period of the authorization by the specified days (`authorization_days`). For instance, when `authorization_days` is 30, you'll request the authorization to be extended by 30 days.
| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tcm/tt_video/apply/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "tcm_account_id":"{{tcm_account_id}}", "video_id":"{{video_id}}", "authorization_days": 30 }' (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message |string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id|string| Unique ID of the request. | |data|object|Returned data.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": {} } (/code) ```
